footer.note: C++ runs your programs. HTML, CSS and a bit of JavaScript only draw the page.
ui.answersHint: One per line. ask takes them in order, top to bottom.
ui.importHint: Paste a lessons file here. It gets added to your own, not over them.
ui.pickFile: Pick a file on the left first.
console.empty: Nothing has run yet. Press Run.
console.nothing: empty file. Bold, but there is nothing to run.
console.hidden: {count} earlier lines are folded away. The limit lives in Settings.
console.needAnswers: It asked a question and got nothing. Put the answers in the box above and run it again.
files.emptyHint: Make one, or bring back the examples and read those first.
files.starter:
note: Rename me, or write over me.

tutorial.missing: Not a lesson we know about.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Every switch here is read by the server as it builds the page. Nothing is stored in your browser.
settings.source: The whole page comes from data/settings.json.
about.title: Why this exists
about.origin: E++ started as a joke about programming languages that you have to type the way you talk. The joke turned into a real language, and this build is the third engine underneath it: C++ for the lexer, the parser, the interpreter and the six libraries. The browser draws pages and asks the engine questions. It does not run your programs.
extensions.note: A file that stands on its own is .eppl. The moment it loads a library the IDE renames it .eppla — one extra letter, and no argument about it.
reference.cheatsheet:
note: everything after note: is ignored

Define name as Ada.
Set name to "Grace".
say "Hello, " plus 'name' plus "!"

ask "How old are you?" and save answer as age
if 'age' is greater than 12 and 'age' is less than 120 then
  say "Sounds about right."
otherwise
  say "Pull the other one."
end if

repeat 3 times
  say 'name'
end repeat

Increase age by 1
decrease age by 1
display 7 divided by 8 as fraction

note: Libraries need one line each. Save the file as .eppla.
add library "Math"
say square root of 144
say random number between 1 and 6
toast.copyFailed: Copying failed. Select the text and do it yourself.
toast.runFailed: The engine did not answer. Is the server still up?
toast.saveFailed: That save did not take. Look at the console.
ui.renameHint: Keep it short and keep the ending it already has.
ui.newHint: Letters, digits and dashes. What you write decides the ending.
error.notFound: That address leads nowhere. The file may have been renamed, or it was never there.
ui.deleteSure: No undo, no recycle bin, no second thoughts.
